sentences.en: The subscription is worth it if you travel a lot.
sentences.zh: 如果你经常旅行的话，订阅是值得的。

sentences.en: All subscriptions must be paid before the end of this year.
sentences.zh: 所有订阅都必须在本年底之前支付。

sentences.en: When you buy a <xxx> television get 1 year of subscription free.
sentences.zh: 购买一台<xxx>电视可免费获得一年的订阅服务。

senses.zh: （报刊等的）订阅费,捐款,（俱乐部的）会员费,捐助
